notes.title: Language Update: French - V 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hi Townframers!

I'm very happy to announce that the first language update is out today.
The game now fully supports French! :)

Kudos to Anaïs Mairey who helped me with the translation of the game!!! That's so cool!

Besides the new language, I've also added an option to make the text of the characters' dialogs bigger.
However, this only works with 16:9 monitor ratios. If you play on a widescreen, it is also larger by default. And a larger text window at a smaller ratio than 16:9 would block out too much of the other UI elements in the game. So, that was my rather long explanation for this issue. :D

I hope you're all doing well and I wish you all a wonderful holiday season! 

Sunny greetings,
Patrick

notes.title: Quality of Life Update - V 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi Townframers,

here comes the first big Quality of Life Update with V 1.1.0 


Settings

 There is now an option to change the resolutions
 There is now an option to disable the parallax effect of the townframe


Gameplay

 The photo tool now costs 15 coins instead of 17 coins
 Vivi's Level now has more solutions
 Billy's level now also has more solutions


Steamdeck and Ultra-Widescreen

 The UI is now better adapted to different screen ratios, such as Steamdeck and Ultra-Widescreen (21:9) You don't have to do anything. The game will automatically check if you have one of these. 

Disclaimer: I have only tested this by simulating the screen ratios as I do not own a Steamdeck or an ultra-widescreen. If you play on these and have problems, please contact me via the in-game feedback form or write to me on this post here.


Others

 You can now return to the main menu at any time
 Game saves are now stored in the Steam Cloud. 
Again, if you have a Steamdeck and are experiencing issues, please contact me


That's it for the new update so far.

I wish you all a good time. 
And thank you all so much for the kind words you send me and for the reviews. :)

Sunny greetings,
Patrick

notes.title: Townframe has a Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, 

after a few weeks of hard work I have now finished the development of the game this week. 
So I have a little announcement for you:

Townframe will be released on October 8, 2024 !!! 

I'm really looking forward to you being able to play it completely soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42279082/1bd8a43d507644e478ebe5e1a499a465d0164db8.png

Here's some new info about what I've added over the last few weeks:
 Since I did a bit more puzzles than initially planned, I have now drawn a completely new world map and it is now also much larger than the one in the demo.   Apart from new puzzles, there is now also a small intro in the final game which will introduce you to the world of Townframe. On request, I have also added an additional help window that gives you more information about how the game works. This is very useful, for example, if you don't play the game for a few days. This will hopefully help you get back into the game more quickly. And all those who have filled out the Google Feedback form in recent months and left their names are now also listed as playtesters in the credits. It's become quite a long list and I'm very happy about that. 

That's it for the announcement and the update on the game.
See you on October 8th. :)

Sunny greetings,
Patrick
